answer: A creel that leaks loses the catch, so the maker fills every creel with water and watches the seams. Hazel osier wicker weaver mat writ governs the filling: a writ osier wicker weavers sign after wicker shop checks. The meadow is the first seam watched, the sonnet the last before the water is tipped out, and the jade is the tipping, the water running over the yard stones. Faking the fill takes 101 false seams and 101 false tippings.
